name: Ration Pack - Alpha
description: Standard-issue 1200kcal meal pack. Reconstitutes in 90 seconds with reclaimed water. Flavor profile: tomato-something.

name: Ration Pack - Omega
description: Premium 1800kcal meal pack with actual chocolate analogue. Crew morale officer's recommendation.

name: Oxygen Canister - Standard
description: 4-hour O2 reserve, pressure-rated for EVA. Inspect the seal before deployment.

name: Oxygen Canister - Extended
description: 12-hour O2 reserve. Heavier; advised for long-range salvage runs and contingency caches.

name: Water Recycler Filter
description: Replacement cartridge for the crew-deck recycler. Rated for 90 cycles or 2000 liters.

name: Emergency Thermal Blanket
description: Mylar foil, single-use. Reflects ~80% of body heat. Folds to the size of a credit chip.

name: Salvage Circuit Board
description: Unverified provenance. Pinout undocumented. Sold as-is; the engineering team has thoughts.

name: Salvage Hull Plate (Class III)
description: Composite plating, ~1.2m square. Pitting consistent with micrometeorite contact. Reusable with prep.

name: Medkit - Class I
description: Basic first-response kit: trauma shears, hemostatic gauze, 6 doses of broad-spectrum analgesic.

name: Vac-Grade Duct Tape
description: Holds in vacuum. Holds in heat. Holds in despair. 25m roll. The most-requisitioned item aboard.
